definitions.note:fee: fees are excluded from every markout; venue_fees.fee_kalshi_maker(1, p) = 0.01 at interior p under the repo's one-cent rounding assumption (venue_fees.py docstring :8-12)
definitions.note:identity: inputs identity = bytes plus sha256 of the first and last 1 MiB of each shard; a change inside the middle of a shard that keeps size and both end megabytes is NOT detected
definitions.note:joins: join instants overlap and may share prints; they are counterfactuals, not a policy
